mapper.select: SELECT a.approval_id AS approvalId, ar.title AS title FROM file_version fv JOIN approval_document ad ON ad.file_version_id = fv.file_version_id AND ad.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN approval_revision ar ON ar.approval_revision_id = ad.approval_revision_id AND ar.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN approval a ON a.approval_id = ar.approval_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE fv.file_id = #{fileId} AND a.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' ORDER BY a.approval_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM file_version fv JOIN approval_document ad ON ad.file_version_id = fv.file_version_id JOIN approval_revision ar ON ar.approval_revision_id = ad.approval_revision_id JOIN approval a ON a.approval_id = ar.approval_id WHERE fv.file_id = #{fileId} AND (ad.deleted_at IS NULL OR ar.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) )

SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM file_version fv JOIN approval_document ad ON ad.file_version_id = fv.file_version_id AND ad.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN approval_revision ar ON ar.approval_revision_id = ad.approval_revision_id AND ar.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN approval_line al ON al.approval_revision_id = ar.approval_revision_id AND al.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE fv.file_id = #{fileId} AND al.user_id = #{userId} )
